name: 北海公园
experience_value: Softens imperial Beijing by replacing hard monument rhythm with garden-and-water breathing space.
Useful when the route needs recovery after major landmarks without losing historical tone.
Creates a more graceful pacing option for couple and solo itineraries than another packed attraction.
avoid_when: the itinerary already has too many large park segments and needs street texture instead
the traveler wants a highly budget-compressed day with minimal ticketed stops
winter weather makes water-and-garden value too weak relative to indoor or food-led alternatives
